options.take: One or two presenters read the script to camera: vertical 1080x1920, 30 fps, eyes in the upper third, clean close-mic audio, no music under the voice.
options.layout: face in the kit's face zone; overlays use the empty space around it

options.take: Synthesize the two voices locally from the script with a voice whose licence allows publication, then build a faceless layout.
options.layout: a framed card (waveform, title or b-roll) takes the face zone's place; overlays frame it and never cover it

source.consent: Record only people who agreed to appear, and keep their written consent with the production.

edit.hook: Open on the question: How did web pages get live updates before WebSockets?
must_show: the Upgrade request typed out live (GET /chat HTTP/1.1, Host, Upgrade: websocket, Connection: Upgrade, Sec-WebSocket-Key, Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13)
the server answer 101 Switching Protocols with Sec-WebSocket-Accept, as an animated UI panel
edit.optional_trim: If the take runs long, the board may drop the 'Any other status code' line.
